seance: "My clock lies... the beast came early... it came in from the rain."

rooms.name: Ruth's Cabin
rooms.info: Ruth the caretaker's own little cabin, a short walk from the lodge. Searchable in Round 2.

rooms.name: Generator
rooms.info: The backup generator, just outside the mudroom.

rooms.name: Back Porch (covered)
rooms.info: A covered porch along the back of the lodge. The mudroom's back door and the study's French doors both open onto it.

rooms.name: Mudroom
rooms.info: Boots, coats and the breaker box. The back door leads out to the porch. The umbrella stand is sealed until Puzzle 3 is solved.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.info: Connects to the mudroom, the Great Room and the back stairs up to the guest rooms. A window looks out toward the back door.

rooms.name: Hallway
rooms.info: The only inside way to the study. It opens straight off the Great Room. There's a coat closet here.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.info: Edgar's private study, where he was found. One door to the hallway, and French doors out to the back porch. His safe is sealed until Puzzle 1 is solved.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.info: Where dinner was served at 8:30. Opens onto the Great Room.

rooms.name: Great Room
rooms.info: The heart of the party. Somebody was in here all night.

rooms.name: Guest Rooms
rooms.info: Upstairs, reached by the back stairs in the kitchen. Everyone's luggage is here, sealed until Puzzle 2 is solved.

rooms.name: Foyer
rooms.info: The front entrance, off the Great Room.

rooms.name: Front Porch
rooms.info: Outside the front door. Exposed to the storm.
